<description>
Pr #33223  adjusts the weight selection to keep the lighter coin when two coins have the same value, but the test has two mistakes

1. It builds `mixed_weight_pool` but passes `utxo_pool` to `TestSRDSuccess`.
2. There is nothing enforcing coin eviction because the current max weight (`4 * 3 * 67` = 804 WU) fits any two coins (544 WU)

The old existing test does not check the fix:
If you reverse #33223, it still passes 20/20 tests, which means it misses the tie-break
Other coin selection tests like `spend_tests`, `wallet_send.py`, `wallet_fundrawtransaction.py` do not catch the broken tie-break
The fix
The PR uses `mixed_weight_pool` instead of `utxo_pool`.
The PR adds an extra light coin so that only two light coins can fit together and evicts a coin on every tie to pass.
It also lowers the max weight to `4 * 2 * (P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1)` = 536 WU; SRD now has to evict the heavier coin on every tie to succeed
Adds a second (67 vB) light coin to the pool
This should show 20/20 failed tests with [bitcoin#33223](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/33223) reverted and 20/20 passing without the revert
Steps to reproduce:
Revert the #33223  change in `src/wallet/coinselection.cpp`

```
git show eff9e798b9 -- src/wallet/coinselection.cpp | git apply -R
```

Build and run the tests

```
cmake --build build --target test_bitcoin
build/bin/test_bitcoin --run_test=coinselection_tests/srd_test
```

Expected results: After the revert, it should fail on this PR and pass on master
</description>

<commits>
2ade73da7a test: fix SRD tie-break test

The test in #33223 builds `mixed_weight_pool` but passes
`utxo_pool` to `TestSRDSuccess`, and the max weight (804 WU) fits
any two coins, so SRD never evicts and the tie-break never runs.

Pass `mixed_weight_pool` instead of `utxo_pool`.
add an extra light coin and lower the max weight to 536 WU so that
the heavier coin gets evicted on every tie.
add checks to assert the resulting utxos on success
Call `SelectCoinsSRD` directly and check the number and total weight
of the selected inputs.
</commits>

<patch>
diff --git a/src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp b/src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp
index f470fd1f3b..6051ed9db0 100644
--- a/src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp
+++ b/src/wallet/test/coinselection_tests.cpp
@@ -313,8 +313,12 @@ BOOST_AUTO_TEST_CASE(srd_test)
         std::vector<OutputGroup> mixed_weight_pool;
         AddDuplicateCoins(mixed_weight_pool, /*count=*/100, /*amount=*/5 * CENT, cs_params);
         mixed_weight_pool.push_back(MakeCoin(5 * CENT, true, cs_params, /*custom_spending_vsize=*/P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1));
-        TestSRDSuccess("Tie-break same effective value with lower weight", utxo_pool, /*selection_target=*/9 * CENT, cs_params,
-        /*max_selection_weight=*/4 * 3 * (P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1));
+        mixed_weight_pool.push_back(MakeCoin(5 * CENT, true, cs_params, /*custom_spending_vsize=*/P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1));
+        const auto result = SelectCoinsSRD(mixed_weight_pool, /*target_value=*/9 * CENT, cs_params.m_change_fee, cs_params.rng_fast,
+                                           /*max_selection_weight=*/4 * 2 * (P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1));
+        BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL(result->GetInputSet().size(), 2U);
+        BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL(result->GetWeight(), 4 * 2 * (P2WPKH_INPUT_VSIZE - 1));
+        BOOST_CHECK(result->GetSelectedEffectiveValue() >= 9 * CENT + cs_params.m_change_fee + CHANGE_LOWER);
     }
 }
 

</patch>
